summary: Canva's main friction themes include user experience degradation, AI integration backlash, and feature complexity. Positive feedback highlights its ease of use, versatility, and value for non-designers.

themes.name: User Experience Degradation
themes.description: Users report clunky interface, loss of fine control, and overall poor UX, especially in the free version. Complaints include difficulty zooming, positioning elements, and navigating the app.
themes.recommendation: Revisit core UX design, restore fine control features, and improve navigation.

themes.name: Feature Complexity
themes.description: Users find the app overwhelming due to the number of features, especially when trying to create more complex designs. Some feel the learning curve is steep.
themes.recommendation: Add more onboarding and tutorial content to help users navigate the app.

themes.name: AI Integration Backlash
themes.description: Strong pushback against AI features, with users feeling they're forced into AI-driven workflows and losing control over design elements.
themes.recommendation: Offer AI as an optional feature, not a default, and provide clear opt-out mechanisms.

themes.name: Premium Feature Limitations
themes.description: Users feel many advanced features are locked behind paywalls, and some premium features (like magic layer) are not working as expected.
themes.recommendation: Ensure premium features are functional and consider offering more free tools to retain users.
